summary: Listed as Caswell (Yanceyville) in a North Carolina tower list, about 38 m from the Forest Service office on Fire Tower Road; no build, height or fate source found.

evidence.supports: Tower list entry: Caswell (Yanceyville) at 36.42027, -79.33694, Caswell County
FDmaps lists the NCFS Caswell County Office at 973 Fire Tower Rd
FDmaps address line for the office
Office at the junction of State Roads 1572 and 1589, about 1 mile north of the Yanceyville courthouse
evidence.quote: The Caswell County office is located at the junction of State Roads 1572 and 1589, (Fire Tower Road) which is about 1 mile north of Yanceyville Court House.

sources.title: N.C. Forest Service Contacts - Caswell County

notes_for_editor: Thin record, deliberately short. No source reachable says when a tower was built, its height or staffing, or whether one stands at the Forest Service office today, so none of that is written. The story is below the 120-word floor because the evidence does not support more; it was not padded. The 38-metre figure (38.4 m great-circle) is my calculation from the two published coordinates (tower list 36.42027, -79.33694; FDmaps 36.420576, -79.337138). Facebook fire-tower group posts describe a 99-foot Aermotor at the office, but the fetched pages returned no body text, so nothing from them is used and an editor may want to check them by hand. Brief status and access 'unknown' are kept unknown; no access level is written because no source describes public access to a tower here.
